description: Java class implementing X509 certificate validation against tenant trust anchors in the Hono platform, including methods for certificate path validation, tenant lookup, and credential extraction.

classes.name: TenantServiceBasedX509Authentication
classes.description: Java class for validating X.509 client certificates against tenant trust anchors, with methods for certificate validation, tenant retrieval, and credential extraction.

methods.name: validateClientCertificate
methods.description: Validates a certificate path by retrieving tenant info and trust anchors, then validates the certificate chain and extracts credentials.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on the issuer DN of the client certificate.

methods.name: getX509CertificatePath
methods.description: Converts an array of Certificates to a list of X509Certificates, failing if unsupported types are encountered.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Extracts subject DN and tenant ID from the validated certificate chain and tenant info, returning as JSON.
